title: Hidden_armor
description: Are you still bothered by your armor covering up your skin? This resource pack can hide your armor and show off your nice skin.
body:
你还在烦扰盔甲挡住了你的皮肤吗？本资源包可以隐藏你的盔甲，露出自己好看的皮肤。装配上该资源包后，穿上铁甲钻石甲等装备将不再显示盔甲纹理。
Are you still annoyed by the armor covering your skin? This resource pack allows you to hide your armor and reveal your beautiful skin.
